# Matthew Pelnik

> Matthew Pelnik is a Data Analyst in the Tulsa, Oklahoma area. He works for a contractor for CMS (Medicare), creating proactive models to find provider fraud. Most of his work is in Databricks, using Python and Spark.

Outside of work, he plays tennis and kickball in local leagues.

## Stats

- College Degree: Chemical Engineering
- College GPA: 3.76
- ACT: 34
